description: Data collection for final-report 1D figures. No figure files are generated.
N_note: These values are passed directly to Config1D.N. In the current code this gives interior_size = N - 1, matching the requested 16, 32, 64, 128, 256 interior unknowns.

performance_convergence_policy.required: Figure 1 and Figure 2 performance rows must converge by tol_update.
performance_convergence_policy.failure_behavior: raise RuntimeError before writing an invalid performance row

omega_refinement.linear_note: Linear SOR searches are centered on the spectral predicted omega.
omega_refinement.nonlinear_note: Nonlinear SOR searches are broad experimental sweeps only; no spectral prediction is used.
omega_refinement.nonlinear_selection_policy: Select the best converged omega on the first contiguous converged branch; ignore later isolated converged pockets after the first failed candidate.

exploratory_failsafe.applies_to: Omega optimization and Figure 4 sensitivity sweeps only.

figure5_plateau.reported_error: mean numerical error over the final plateau window

discrepancies_resolved: The instructions call N a total grid-point count, but Config1D.N produces N-1 interior unknowns and an x array with N+1 entries. The script uses the requested N values as Config1D.N because that matches the requested interior-unknown counts.
Spectral-analysis predictions are used only for the linear problem. Nonlinear SOR optima are selected by experimental broad sweep plus local refinement.
Figure 3 does not name a problem. The script fixes it to the linear problem because the requested predicted-vs-experimental comparison depends on spectral analysis.
Figure 4 is fixed to the nonlinear problem and does not use spectral predictions. Its omega_predicted values are null and is_predicted_omega is false.
